instructions: Use only the preanswer-clamped responder bundle, including its responder README and blank response template. Do not consult custody kit, custody evidence template, scorer kit, score sheet template, full archive, handoff manifest, answer-key material, expected bundle digest, prior conversation, or the old submission kit before finishing responder_stage. Compute the SHA256 of the responder bundle you were handed and paste that observed digest into saw_responder_bundle_sha256; no expected bundle digest is visible before response. Treat each packet as a separate bounded cue set: answer it only from its own packet_surfaces and visible_task_cues, and record the minutes spent on that packet.
non_claim: responder-only packet; not scorer material, not custody material, not external certification, not compact-cue confirmation, not deletion authority, not benchmark authority, and not a bundle-hash witness by itself

full trace does not make same-session scoring independent

compact gate decisions remain reversible and evidence-bound

responder_instruction: Answer each packet from that packet alone without seeing custody kit, scorer intake, score sheet, answer key, full archive, old submission kit, or prior conversation. Record per-packet timing, total timing, and abstentions. After response freeze, a distinct custodian will freeze a custody record before any scorer kit opens, and a separate scorer will then record scorer-kit opening and scoring chronology; do not self-certify custody or score yourself. Because all packet cues are co-visible, the eventual result is bounded semantic evidence rather than a causal compact-versus-full burden trial.
evidence_scope: single-responder co-visible synthetic packet slice; packet-delta is a trace excerpt, not a measured full archive
